name: Nayuta
source:
“I promised… that I would never make anyone suffer again.”

He is a boy who lives in a Western-style mansion on the outskirts of town and carries a somewhat mature air. With an aloof, hard-to-grasp personality, he comes across as curt and sarcastic. Strongly responsible by nature, he possesses a sharp intellect along with decisiveness and the ability to act. Having lost his memories of the past, he works as a detective while searching for clues to recover who he once was.
